title: fix(ui): judge requiredWhen as a transition gate on the console form page and the kanban drop prompt
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-support-ai"} -->
_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwBY37urno69QP7HQ4DEeF5Fw)_

Refs #30220

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:控制台表单页(`/forms/:name?recordId=` 编辑)和看板拖放提示,改为按引擎的方式判 `requiredWhen`(转移闸门):记录本来就处在闸门内且缺值时,不再拦住无关编辑、也不再弹窗索要该字段;把记录移入闸门、清空已有值的编辑照旧拦截。编辑向导(WizardForm)未改,需要你裁决(见下方 Open question)。
- 为什么改:#30216 只修了记录编辑表单;同一条已激活但缺签字件的合同,在表单页保存会报「Required: Signed Copy」,在看板上拖到别的优先级列会弹窗索要签字件,而 REST `PATCH` 本身返回 200。
- 风险与回滚:只改客户端判定,两处各加一个 `name` 参数,读的是 #30216 已有的 `requiredWhenAtRest`,没有第二套规则;最坏情况是客户端放行、服务端拒绝,拒绝信息照常显示。回滚即还原本 PR。
- 先看:`ui/apps/console/src/components/FormPage.tsx`(`resolveRowState` 的 statics 多了 `name: field.name`)、`ui/packages/plugin-kanban/src/requiredWhenPrompt.ts`(statics 多了 `name`)、`FormPage.conditionalRules.test.tsx` 新增的 describe。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run apps/console/src/components/FormPage.conditionalRules.test.tsx packages/plugin-kanban/src/requiredWhenPrompt.test.ts`,预期 39 个用例全绿,其中「saves an unrelated edit to a record already inside the gate without the value」与「asks for nothing when the stored record already rests inside the gate」通过。
- 需要你做的:在 #30220 上裁决编辑向导这一处(是否允许把已存记录只传给 `requiredWhenRestsOnStoredRecord`),其余两处席位落地。

## What changes

The engine's rule (`packages/objectql/src/validation/rule-validator.ts`, the "ADR-0113 non-regression: reject iff the MERGED state violates AND the PRE state complied" block, `preViolated`) refuses an update only when the merged record violates `requiredWhen` and the stored row complied. #30216 mirrored that in `@object-ui/core` `resolveFieldRuleState`: given `previous` (the stored row) and `statics.name`, a stored row already inside the gate without the value resolves `required: false` / `requiredWhenAtRest: true`. A caller that passes no `name` keeps the plain verdict. This PR makes two more callers pass it:

- **Console form page** (`ui/apps/console/src/components/FormPage.tsx`, `resolveRowState`): it already passed the stored record (`loaded.record`, the `GET /data/:object/:id` row) as `previous`; it now passes `name: field.name`. The asterisk, `aria-required` and the page's own submit check (`findSubmitRefusals`) all read this one verdict, so all three follow. A create form passes no `previous` and is unchanged.
- **Kanban drop prompt** (`ui/packages/plugin-kanban/src/requiredWhenPrompt.ts`, `collectRequiredWhenPromptFields`): it already passed the pre-drop record as `previous`; it now passes `name`. A drop of a record already inside the gate without the value issues the plain single-key `PATCH` with no dialog; a drop that moves a compliant record into the gate still opens the "Complete required fields" dialog.

No new rule and no change in `@object-ui/core`. No engine-side door: the engine already implements the gate (the `preViolated` check), so there is no `domain:server` half.

### Not changed: the edit wizard (open question)

`ui/packages/plugin-form/src/WizardForm.tsx` `gateFinalSubmit` passes `undefined` as `previous` in both modes, so `requiredWhenAtRest` is always `false` there and an Edit wizard on a record already inside the gate is refused at the final submit (each step's own form renders with `previousValues` and already lets it through since #30216). Its note fences this:

> ⚠️ This gate binds no `previous` in either mode (see the `serverOwnedValue` note below), so a `visibleWhen` reading `previous` is unevaluable here even on an EDIT wizard, and is refused. objectui#8069's ruling declined new binding for `previous` ("no new binding pipelines", its option D) and accepted the create-form half of that as the residual; the edit-wizard half is the same mechanism, accepted as a residual under the same refusal of option D on objectui#8069 — ⛔ so `persistedRecord` is deliberately NOT bound here.

The order asked to read the ruling text first; objectstack-ai/objectui is outside this session's GitHub access, and the repository holds only the paraphrase above (and the ADR-0137 header naming the ruling). So the wizard site is left untouched and reported on the card as `needs_decision`, with these options:

- **A (recommended).** In `gateFinalSubmit`, on an Edit wizard only, after the live verdict, call `requiredWhenRestsOnStoredRecord(field.requiredWhen, name, persistedRecord, predicateScope)` and skip the field when it answers true and the field is not statically required. The live `resolveFieldRuleState` call still binds no `previous`, so the `visibleWhen` fault residual the ruling accepted is unchanged; the stored row reaches only the stored-row check, which can only relax a `requiredWhen`, never reports a fault, and counts an unevaluable predicate as compliant. `persistedRecord` already feeds this component (`gateFormFields` `previousValues`, and the step renderer's `previousValues`). About 10 lines plus one pin and one control.
- **B.** Pass `persistedRecord` as the gate's live `previous` on an Edit wizard. This is the binding the ruling refused (it would also change the `visibleWhen` fault answer), so not recommended.
- **C.** Keep the wizard as an accepted residual: an Edit wizard cannot save a record already inside a `requiredWhen` gate, while the record Edit form, the form page and the board can.

## Why

#30216 fixed the record Edit form only. The same record (a contract activated before its signed-copy rule existed) was still refused by the console form page ("Required: Signed Copy") and prompted for the signed copy by a kanban drop into another priority column, while REST `PATCH` answers 200 for both writes.

## Tests

- `FormPage.conditionalRules.test.tsx` (the file's existing harness, new top-level describe, real `FormPage` on `/forms/:name?recordId=`): a record already activated with no signed copy shows no required marker and saves an unrelated edit (one `PATCH`, body carries the edit). CONTROL: clearing the value of an activated record that held it is refused (marker shown, `toast.error`, no write).
- `requiredWhenPrompt.test.ts` (new top-level describe): a record already inside the gate dropped into another column of an unrelated grouping collects nothing. CONTROL: a draft dropped into `activated` still collects `signed_copy`.

## Acceptance notes

- `Clause-②: no`: `resolveRowState` and `collectRequiredWhenPromptFields` keep their signatures; only the verdict for a stored row already inside the gate changes.
- The after-leg form page shot shows the post-submit record page under the fresh boot's "Set the default currency" dialog; the "Submitted" toast and the `PATCH ... -> 200` reading are the evidence.

## Verification

Head: `4febaa77` (base `origin/main` merged at `959c26be`).

<details><summary>Browser check on a dev boot (showcase, fresh, built from this branch at origin/main 31260ca8 + this diff; Vite console serving src)</summary>

Seeded by API as admin: writable package `com.qa.rwgate`, object `rwgate_contract` (status draft/activated, priority low/high, `signed_copy` text) with three rows inserted BEFORE the rule existed, then the object re-saved with `signed_copy.requiredWhen: record.status == 'activated'`; a kanban grouped by priority (default list), a kanban grouped by status (`by_status`), a simple form view, an app.

Engine control on the same boot (REST): `PATCH` the activated row with no signed copy `{priority: high}` answered 200; `PATCH` the draft row `{status: activated}` answered 400 `VALIDATION_FAILED` ("Signed Copy is required").

| Leg | Before (fix removed from src, Vite restarted `--force`, served code checked) | After (this branch) |
|:--|:--|:--|
| Form page, Edit of the activated row with no signed copy, rename, Submit | label `Signed Copy*`, refused "Required: Signed Copy", no write | label `Signed Copy`, `PATCH /data/rwgate_contract/0zgY… -> 200`, "Submitted" |
| Form page CONTROL, clear the signed copy of a compliant activated row | refused, no write | refused, no write (label `Signed Copy*`) |
| Kanban by priority, drag the activated row with no signed copy Low to High | "Complete required fields" dialog, no write | no dialog, `PATCH ... -> 200`, card in High |
| Kanban by status CONTROL, drag the draft row Draft to Activated | dialog asks for Signed Copy | dialog asks for Signed Copy, no write |

Shots: `/mnt/project-files/ui-orders/30220-shots/` (`before-1..4`, `after-1..4`, one per leg). The boot and the Vite server were stopped after the run (health 000).
</details>
